title: AI stratifies AMD severity and predicts progression to late AMD
summary: An ensemble of deep learning methods trained on 116,875 color fundus photos from 4139 AREDS participants classified AMD severity with 99.2% accuracy for referral-level disease. A logistic model tree combining AMD scores with clinical and imaging data predicted 2-year incident late AMD with 86.36% accuracy, but only 66.88% for late dry and 67.15% for late wet AMD. External validation used the NAT-2 study; the NAT-2 figures were truncated in the abstract reviewed.
ai_technology: Ensemble of deep learning screening models plus a logistic model tree for progression prediction

evidence.tested: Trained and validated on the AREDS dataset, with external validation on the NAT-2 study.
evidence.unknown: NAT-2 external performance figures were not visible in the abstract text; prospective use; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Grades AMD severity on fundus photographs and predicts 1- and 2-year progression to late dry or wet AMD.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; first-author affiliations from Crossref. Publisher full text not accessed.
